title: Share your training
summary: Choose who sees your training, follow other members, and approve who follows you.
changes: Make your profile Private, Friends only or Public in Profile > Profile sharing.
Follow public profiles, request to follow friends-only ones, and approve or decline requests.
Your workouts and profile photo are always shared; add machine photos, body weight, goals, cardio or notes if you like.
Open Shared profiles to see the people you follow and manage your followers.

image.alt: Shared profiles with a follow request to approve, profiles you follow, and a friends-only member with a Request to follow button.
